summary: Feed s054_single to IDS is degraded due to tool overload: peak 1.49 Gbps bursts exceed 1 Gbps IDS port (149% capacity, 9 overloaded intervals). All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, VLANs, one-way, packet drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding aggregate traffic that micro-bursts to 1.49 Gbps, exceeding the IDS 1 Gbps port capacity (149% utilization, threshold 80%). No load-balancing or filtering is applied before the tool, so ingress buffers overflow during bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS drops packets randomly during bursts, causing incomplete TCP reassembly, missed signatures and flows, and reduced detection coverage - IDS needs both directions and full payload but cannot inspect what it does not receive.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across 2x 1Gbps IDS ports/instances via 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port load below 80% while preserving both directions and full payload required by IDS. If scaling is not possible, apply filter to forward only required VLANs 10,20 and relevant traffic.
